ASTRA Research

Teradyne forecast rises with stronger AI testing demand

Posted 20 Oct 2026, 8:40 am GMT-4

Research update | 20 October 2026 | ASTRA Research

ASTRA Research has raised its Q4 2027 modeled valuation for Teradyne (TER) by about 4%, to $310 per share from $298.

More complex AI chips and high-bandwidth memory require demanding tests before they can be used in expensive systems. New analyst meeting notes suggest stronger demand for the equipment that performs those tests.

Our revised forecast adds a 25% probability-weighted sales scenario above growth already included in the model. It allows for extra manufacturing, engineering and customer-support costs. A supplier's production plan still has to become delivered equipment and accepted sales.

The original analyst identity and report date are absent from the supplied excerpts. The change is our research judgment, with customer acceptance and costs remaining key uncertainties. Teradyne's next results are scheduled for October 27.

The valuation remains a model estimate. It uses the existing earnings multiple and share assumptions.

Company reference: Teradyne reporting-date announcement.

ASTRA Research

AAOI AIXTRON and Microsoft forecast updates

Posted 19 Oct 2026, 11:16 pm GMT-4

Research update | 19 October 2026 | ASTRA Research

Our latest research update adjusts optical production and equipment pricing assumptions and corrects Microsoft's nearer-term margin forecast. The figures below are our model estimates, with Q4 2026 and Q4 2027 shown separately.

Applied Optoelectronics AAOI

Our model now includes a 25% chance that the 800G production ramp runs a quarter behind the previous forecast. These high-speed optical connections link AI chips and servers. A slower ramp would delay sales while leaving some factory costs in place.

The Q4 2026 valuation falls about 4% to $236. The Q4 2027 estimate falls less than 1% to about $463 because the modeled delay is temporary. The analyst notes behind the change leave the exact production measurement unclear, so accepted shipments remain the key test.

AIXTRON AIXA

Tight supplies of optical manufacturing tools could help AIXTRON secure higher prices on eligible new orders. Our revised model includes a small probability-weighted benefit after delivery, depreciation and support costs.

The Q4 2027 valuation rises less than 1% to about EUR 100. The size of the eligible order pool and the price premium remain assumptions. Existing fixed-price orders receive no increase.

Microsoft MSFT

Aligning our forecast with previously published company guidance lowers estimated FY2027 operating profit by about 2% to $176 billion. The Q4 2026 valuation falls about 2% to $486, while Q4 2027 remains about $571.

Our growth forecast already includes a substantial data-center buildout. The latest capacity estimates do not establish additional sales above that path.

These estimates will be revisited as production, contract terms and earnings develop.

Quarterly roll-forward Upside & EV Upside now use Q4 2027 Posted 30 Sep 2026, 10:51 pm EDT

As Q3 ends and Q4 begins on October 1, we have rolled the reference quarter for Upside and EV Upside from Q3 2027 to Q4 2027. This keeps the dashboard focused roughly 12 months ahead. The change was applied on September 30, just ahead of the new quarter.

  • Upside: Q4 2027 target price divided by the current share price.
  • EV Upside: Uses the same Q4 2027 target and current share price, with the existing Base-score weighting.

Figures can change because we are looking one quarter further ahead, not necessarily because a company’s outlook has been upgraded. The roll-forward itself does not change Base scores or quarterly forecasts.

Next planned roll-forward: January 1, 2027.
